title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 64 (Callaghan Road)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Callaghan Road
64 That portion of the Province of British Columbia within 400 metres of the road allowance of Callaghan Road between the northwest corner of the Resort Municipality of Whistler and the gate at Whistler Olympic Park. [en. B.C. Reg. 169/2020, App. 1, s. 1.]
